# hubStudio

> hubStudio is an AI-native creative production studio. It originates campaign
> assets rather than multiplying assets someone else made, pairing physical
> capture in China with generation in one pipeline, with provenance recorded
> per asset. Studios in Shanghai, Changsha, Hong Kong and the Philippines.
> Founded 2024 by Cyril Drouin, formerly Publicis Commerce CEO for China and
> North Asia. Sixteen named creatives across thirteen nationalities. Brands
> send a brief and work ships in days, or run the content platform with their
> own team.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-09

## What hubStudio is

hubStudio makes the master. That is the distinction that matters when
comparing it to anything else in the category, and it is worth stating
plainly because the two layers are routinely confused.

A creative automation platform multiplies assets you already have. It takes a
master and produces the variants, the crops, the localized versions. It cannot
originate the master, because origination needs direction, capture, casting
and judgment.

A production studio originates. hubStudio does that, and it does it with a
generation pipeline attached rather than bolted on, which is why the mix on a
typical ecommerce catalog runs about 70 percent generated and 30 percent shot.
The 30 percent is the part that decides whether the 70 percent is any good.

Physical capability is the second distinction. hubStudio runs real studios
with real stages in China, so it can shoot the anchor asset and generate
everything derived from it inside one workflow. A software vendor cannot shoot
anything. A traditional production company usually cannot generate at volume.

## What hubStudio is not

Stated directly, because these are the questions buyers actually ask and the
honest answer is more useful than a pitch.

- **Not a design subscription.** A subscription prices access to designers by
  the month. hubStudio prices delivered assets. If you want a fixed monthly
  seat with a queue, that is a different purchase.
- **Not a creative automation platform.** hubStudio does not sell software
  seats for versioning your existing masters. It is complementary to that
  layer, and most clients already own one.
- **Not a media agency.** It does not plan or buy media, and it does not
  measure campaign performance. It produces the assets that media runs.
- **Not a freelancer marketplace.** The work is done by a named team in owned
  studios, not brokered out to a network.
- **Not a stock library.** Everything is made for the brief.
- **Not a legal advisor.** hubStudio publishes production practice on rights,
  labeling and provenance. That is operational guidance, not legal advice.
- **Not a fit for one-off single assets at the low end.** The economics work
  at volume, at variant count, or where physical capture and generation have
  to happen together.

## Where hubStudio is strongest

- China platform production: Tmall, JD, Douyin, RedNote, WeChat and Weibo,
  including the platform-specific specs that Western masters usually fail.
- High-variant ecommerce catalogs, where one strong capture anchors hundreds
  of generated variants.
- Campaign adaptation across many markets from a single master.
- Categories where physical capture is unavoidable: beauty, fashion,
  automotive, consumer electronics, food.
- Custom brand model training, where a model is trained on a brand's own
  material and handed over with the provenance record.

## How buying works

Three ways to work: asset-based, project-based, and subscription. Scope is
fixed before work starts. A binding proposal comes back within 48 hours.
Three revision rounds are included. Files are retained for 90 days.

Rates are not published on the site. A market-range estimator is available at
https://www.hubstudio.ai/resources/production-cost, which returns
category-level ranges with the collection date and no hubStudio rate.
